mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_package ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_package (name, price, description, is_active, membership_enabled, membership_duration_months, membership_duration_days, pt_enabled, pt_session_count, locker_enabled, locker_duration_months, locker_duration_days, uniform_enabled, uniform_duration_months, uniform_duration_days) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{description}, #{active}, #{membershipEnabled}, #{membershipDurationMonths}, #{membershipDurationDays}, #{ptEnabled}, #{ptSessionCount}, #{lockerEnabled}, #{lockerDurationMonths}, #{lockerDurationDays}, #{uniformEnabled}, #{uniformDurationMonths}, #{uniformDurationDays})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_package SET name=#{name}, price=#{price}, description=#{description}, is_active=#{active}, membership_enabled=#{membershipEnabled}, membership_duration_months=#{membershipDurationMonths}, membership_duration_days=#{membershipDurationDays}, pt_enabled=#{ptEnabled}, pt_session_count=#{ptSessionCount}, locker_enabled=#{lockerEnabled}, locker_duration_months=#{lockerDurationMonths}, locker_duration_days=#{lockerDurationDays}, uniform_enabled=#{uniformEnabled}, uniform_duration_months=#{uniformDurationMonths}, uniform_duration_days=#{uniformDurationDays} WHERE id=#{id}
